login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to TeamLens with your email and password.

setup.title: Set up TeamLens
setup.name: Full name
setup.alreadySetup: This server is already set up. Please sign in.

descriptions.account: This server has no accounts yet. Create the first leader account.
descriptions.project: Create the first project and the repositories to collect. You can skip this and do it later in Administration.
descriptions.done: Done! Send the invite link below to your whole team.

setup.repoPatternsHint: For example github.com/acme/* or github.com/acme/web. Sessions outside these repositories never leave a member machine.
setup.inviteExplain: Send this link to your whole team. Each person installs tl on their machine and runs tl join with this link to join.
setup.inviteLater: The invite link expires in 7 days. It is shown only once; create a new one any time in Administration.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least {min} characters.
validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and -, not starting or ending with -.
validation.patternRequired: Enter at least one repository pattern.

cli.title: Open dashboard
cli.invalidTicket: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Run tl open on your machine again.
cli.missingTicket: The sign-in code is missing. Run tl open on your machine to open the dashboard.
